أحترز (form VIII)
# أَحْتَرِزُ (ʔaḥtarizu) /ʔaħ.ta.ri.zu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَزَ (iḥtaraza)
# أَحْتَرِزَ (ʔaḥtariza) /ʔaħ.ta.ri.za/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَرَزَ (iḥtaraza)
# أَحْتَرِزْ (ʔaḥtariz) /ʔaħ.ta.riz/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْتَرَزَ (iḥtaraza)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
